question: What bodily materials of the target may be used in the killing rite?
premises: Flesh is included as an offering material.
The materials belong to the target.
Nails and hair of humans are also specified.
inference: The killing rite may employ the target's flesh as well as human nails and hair.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of naraiḥ alongside nakha-roma is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: One may also use that flesh, and likewise the nails and hair of the intended target.
